items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He used to play with Chris Johnson once in a while

ctx.x: Well, I'm going to get back to Guy Kelly in a minute, because there's a lot I want to ask you about Guy Kelly. But this guy Manuel Roque, what did he...? He didn't play too much around Baton Rouge.

Well, he played with a band. He used to play with Chris Johnson once in a while, and he played with another band called Tody(?) Harris, and another band called Papa Gift's Band... They had about three pretty good bands
